from flask import Flask, request, render_template_string import pymysql import os app = Flask(__name__) # Database connection using environment credentials def get_db_connection(): return pymysql.connect( host=os.environ.get('DB_HOST', 'localhost'), user=os.environ.get('DB_USER', 'app_reader'), password=os.environ.get('DB_PASSWORD', ''), database=os.environ.get('DB_NAME', 'products'), charset='utf8mb4', cursorclass=pymysql.cursors.DictCursor ) @app.route('/search') def search_products(): query = request.args.get('q', '') page_title = request.args.get('title', 'Search Results') # Fetch products matching search conn = get_db_connection() try: with conn.cursor() as cursor: cursor.execute( "SELECT name, description, price FROM products WHERE name LIKE %s LIMIT 20", (f'%{query}%',) ) results = cursor.fetchall() finally: conn.close() # Render results with user-controlled title template = f''' {page_title}

{page_title}

Results for: {query}

{{% for product in products %}} {{% endfor %}}
NameDescriptionPrice
{{{{ product.name }}}} {{{{ product.description }}}} ${{{{ product.price }}}}
''' return render_template_string(template, products=results) @app.route('/product/') def product_detail(product_id): conn = get_db_connection() try: with conn.cursor() as cursor: cursor.execute( "SELECT name, description, price, category FROM products WHERE id = %s", (product_id,) ) product = cursor.fetchone() finally: conn.close() if not product: return "Product not found", 404 detail_template = request.args.get('layout', 'default') if detail_template == 'compact': tpl = '
{{ product.name }} - ${{ product.price }}
' elif detail_template == 'full': tpl = '''

{{ product.name }}

{{ product.description }}

${{ product.price }} {{ product.category }}
''' else: tpl = '
{{ product.name }} - ${{ product.price }}
' return render_template_string(tpl, product=product) @app.route('/report') def generate_report(): """Generate a simple text report of inventory""" report_header = request.args.get('header', 'Inventory Report') conn = get_db_connection() try: with conn.cursor() as cursor: cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(price) as value FROM products") stats = cursor.fetchone() finally: conn.close() report_tpl = f'''

{report_header}

Total products: {{{{ stats.total }}}}

Total value: ${{{{ stats.value }}}}

''' return render_template_string(report_tpl, stats=stats) if __name__ == '__main__': app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8080, debug=False)

environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running Amazon Linux 2, Flask app deployed via systemd. RDS MySQL 8.0 with connection user 'app_reader' configured via parameter group with read_only=ON at session level and GRANT limited to SELECT on products schema only (GRANT SELECT ON products.* TO 'app_reader'@'%'). Instance profile attached with role bounded by permission boundary policy 'infra/pb-readonly-compute' which denies sts:*, s3:PutObject, s3:GetObject, ssm:SendCommand, ssm:StartSession. IMDSv2 enforced (HttpTokens=required, hop limit=1). Network: instance in private subnet with no IGW route, NAT gateway egress restricted via prefix list to only RDS endpoint and package mirrors (pl-rds-only, pl-amzn-repo). Security group ingress only from internal ALB on port 8080. Outbound SG limited to RDS port 3306 and 443 to S3 gateway endpoint (for yum). No direct internet egress path from instance.
